description: This file defines two functions related to calendar formatting in moment.js: getCalendarFormat to determine the appropriate calendar display format based on date difference, and calendar to generate a calendar string for a given time, utilizing formats and hooks.

methods.name: getCalendarFormat(myMoment, now)
methods.description: Determines the format string ('sameDay', 'lastWeek', etc.) based on the difference in days between the provided moment and now.

methods.name: calendar(time, formats)
methods.description: Generates a calendar output string based on the given time and formats, considering local/UTC/offset, and utilizing hooks and locale data.
